name: reports-concurrent-runs-ci-timeout
goal: The concurrent Reports E2E completes under the 15 minute CI test timeout while still proving two runs keep isolated histories and media through the other run's cleanup.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: PR #39 GitHub Harness verify run 39777141955 on 2ff6d35 annotated test/reports-concurrent-runs.e2e.test.ts:65: Test timed out in 900000ms. Expected behavior is the same two-run history and media isolation proof completing under the CI test timeout; the same test passed locally on dc05acd in 575811ms.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing standardized scenario already asserts distinct history homes and commits, media in both histories, first-run cleanup leaving the other history unchanged, 404 for a foreign commit, and final cleanup. The gap is runtime overhead: lasting=60 repeats the whole four-spec run although RunGate already holds teardown and fixture state during the short run. Keep the assertions and use the gate to preserve overlap with fewer repeated browser runs.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
